messages:
Hannah: Surprise lunchtime announcement 1: we quietly crossed $2M ARR overnight! mariachi and custard in the kitchen at 1pm. :tada: :musical_score:
MetricsBot: Milestone logged — ARR = $2,000,000, new_signups_30d = 2,940, monthly_active_customers = 1,020 :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Omar: wait what?! mariachi?? i'm in. will bring tiny sombreros. :tophat: :grinning:
Li: Custard sounds dangerously perfect. any dairy-free option requests? tagging @Zoë. :custard: :question:
Zoë: i can do coconut custard for dairy-free folks. i'll label everything. :label: :coconut:
Carlos: i'll DJ the 90s bops and bring a portable speaker. request song: "We Built This City" (ironic). :headphones:
Priya: remote folks  i'll stream a 2-min zoom toast at 1:05pm PT so folks can clink mugs. short and sweet. :clinking_glasses:
Miguel: posting a tiny metrics snippet for the timeline:
```
ARR: 2000000
MAU: 1020
new_signups_30d: 2940
p95_latency_ms: 84
deploy_ref: release/2026-03-20
errors_5xx_24h: 1
```
Hannah: massive thanks to the payments and infra teams for smoothing the billing edge-case last sprint. huge impact. :heart: @Miguel @Priya
MetricsBot: Snapshot saved to /metrics/milestones/1999999999.json
Omar: tiny poll: sombrero size S/M/L? react with :one: S :two: M :three: L. remote folks vote by emoji.
Li: in-office headcount: Hannah, Omar, Li, Carlos. Miguel dropping custard boxes at front desk. Priya streaming. Zoë labelling desserts.
Zoë: allergy note: coconut labeled, nut-free custard option. please don't leave open spoons. :warning:
Carlos: GIF incoming: <https://giphy.com/gifs/mariachi-celebrate-2MARR|https://giphy.com/gifs/mariachi-celebrate-2MARR>
Priya: five-min toast at 1:05, then brief product retro at 1:12 for anything urgent. tiny celebrations and back to making the platform boringly reliable. congrats team. :rocket:
